identity.title: Checkpoint: Your First Real Layout
identity.description: Synthesize your HTML primitives: assemble a real announcement card from a visual target.

primaryCapability.statement: Synthesize HTML primitives into a complete, properly nested document layout matching a target design.

knows: Opening and closing tags wrap text content
Child elements nest cleanly inside parent elements

Void elements like
and
require no closing tags
canDo: Author individual tags, nested pairs, and divider elements
likelyMisconceptions: Building real components requires complex CSS before getting the HTML structure right

canDo: Replicate a multi-element visual target card using semantic HTML tags.

learning.targetMentalModel: Document flow: the browser stacks elements from top to bottom in the order they appear in source code.

experience.startingState: Learner has learned individual HTML primitives in isolation.
experience.narrativeContext: Time to put the primitives together and replicate a real announcement card.
experience.primaryInteraction: Replicating a visual card using slotted tokens and structural evaluation.
experience.expectedOutcome: Learner successfully reconstructs the target layout with clean semantic HTML.

activities.title: Mission Brief: Replicate the Announcement Card

content.title: Mission Brief: Replicate the Announcement Card
content.hook: Look at the target card. Put your HTML primitives together to recreate it.
content.context: Professional engineers never start with styling. They establish clean, semantic DOM structure first.
goals: Assemble headings, paragraphs, dividers, and buttons in correct document flow

activities.title: Recreate the announcement card
activities.instruction: Recreate the announcement card: a headline, a paragraph, a divider, and an action button.

hints.text: Assemble the tokens in source order: heading, paragraph, horizontal rule, and button.

content.prompt: Recreate the announcement card: a headline, a paragraph, a divider, and an action button.

target.html:
Welcome to Forge

Start building real software.
target.css: body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; background: #090a0f; color: #f4f4f5; padding: 16px; margin: 0; } h1 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 8px 0; color: #ffffff; } p { font-size: 14px; color: #a1a1aa; margin: 0 0 16px 0; line-height: 1.5; } hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid #27272a; margin: 16px 0; } button { background: #f97316; color: #ffffff; border: none; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; }

content.title: Module 1-1 Victory Lap
takeaways: HTML tags define the semantic hierarchy and document flow of the web.
Parent elements wrap children cleanly without overlapping boundaries.

Void elements like
and
stand alone without closing tags.
You now understand tags, nesting, void elements, and document flow.
nextSteps: Ready for Module 1-2: Attributes, Links, and Images.
